scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the class hooks off vs candidate with the hooks on), 12736 isolated CPU pairs for 21 functions of CTaskComplexKillCriminal (8), CTaskComplexKillPedOnFootArmed (8) and CTaskSimplePlayerOnFoot (5 of 10), zero differences, natural completion event with state_restored, layout check ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture in both legs (peds incl. a full CCopPed, criminal, partner, extras, group leader, vehicles, intelligence, player data, fake group with the leader at +0x28, fake tasks with a traced vtable (GetSubTask, GetTaskType, MakeAbortable, destructor) and quiet ones, a fake event with a traced vtable, raw EXE offsets) and compares: return value, the whole memory of the tested object (and of the second object, the partner KillCriminal task), new tasks created in the task pool (type + words without vptr), fake task memory, a fingerprint of all buffers (references masked), reference lists before and after deletion, the full trace (order and count of virtual calls, rand and collaborators), the x87 control word (24-bit precision, sqrt at 24 bits) and an empty x87 stack. Traced stubs, which get NO credit: rand (0x821B1E) and CGeneral::GetRandomNumber, CPed::SetCurrentWeapon(type), SetPedDefaultDecisionMaker, CCarCtrl::JoinCarWithRoadSystem, CPed::Say, CPedGroups::GetPedsGroup, CWorld::GetIsLineOfSightClear, CPed::GetTransformedBonePosition, CCover::FindAndReserveCoverPoint and FindCoordinatesCoverPoint, CPed::ReleaseCoverPoint, CPedIntelligence::SetTaskDuckSecondary, CTaskSimpleDuck::SetDuckTimer and ControlDuckMove, CTaskSimpleUseGun::ControlGunMove, CTaskComplexKillPedOnFootArmed::CreateSubTask (validated separately; returns a marked fake task), CCamera::Using1stPersonWeaponMode and ClearPlayerWeaponMode, CWeaponEffects::ClearCrossHair and CAnimManager::BlendAnimation; for CTaskSimplePlayerOnFoot::ProcessPed the five out-of-bench functions it calls are simulated with traces (which one is called and with what arguments). Run for real, not credited: IsPlayer, RegisterReference/CleanUpOldReference, CCopPed::AddCriminalToKill/SetPartner, CPedIntelligence::FindTaskByType/GetTaskDuck/GetTaskUseGun, CTaskManager::GetTaskSecondary, CPedGroupMembership::GetLeader, CWeapon::IsTypeMelee, CWeaponInfo, CVector::Normalise, CTimer, the task pool and the constructors/destructors of the subtasks created by KillCriminal (EnterCar, CarDrive, LeaveCar, GangDriveBy, KillPedOnFoot) on a full-size fake vehicle. CGame::currArea (0xB72914) and CLoadMonitor::m_eProcLevel (0xB7298C) are changed during LineOfSightClearForAttack and restored. Limits: of CTaskSimplePlayerOnFoot only 5 of its 10 functions are in the bench; OUT of the bench and with NO credit: PlayerControlDucked 0x687F30, PlayerControlZelda 0x6883D0, PlayerControlZeldaWeapon 0x687C20, ProcessPlayerWeapon 0x6859A0 and PlayIdleAnimations 0x6872C0 (they run the real player pad, camera, animation manager/IK, weapon system and crime reporting; ProcessPed only simulates them with traces). The vptr (word 0) and the return value are masked in the constructors and destructors (the task type through GetTaskType is compared instead of the vptr; the destructor return value, EAX, is undefined in the EXE; the final vptr of the destructor is the EXE base vtable vs the DLL one): this applies to the constructors/destructors of the bench, in particular those of CTaskComplexKillCriminal. Bench fixtures corrected after the first run (bench fixes, not source fixes): KC_ABORT now has the cop registered at +0x10 (before it stayed 0xCDCDCDCD and the EXE dereferenced it in CCopPed::AddCriminalToKill) and P_CLUMP uses a fake clump. The bytes +0x1B..+0x1D of KillCriminal and +0x31 of KillPedOnFootArmed are not written by the EXE constructors, so the comparison depends on the 0xCD fill of the pool slots and of the object buffer. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source corrected to what the EXE does before the approved run (uncommitted at the time; see reversing/TaskWave2A/README.md for addresses): see source_corrections_before_run. FIX_BUGS branches removed from the tested functions. Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.

function_scope.CTaskComplexKillCriminal::CreateNextSubT: Corpus 1024; virtual slot 8 (0x68E4F0); source corrected: ENTER_CAR_AS_DRIVER outside a vehicle sets m_CantGetInCar = 1, the criminal-in-vehicle logic was inverted (criminal in vehicle => chase by car; on foot => d^2 <= 625 goes on foot), LEAVE_CAR checks m_pVehicle not bInVehicle, subtasks without a case return 0.

function_scope.CTaskComplexKillPedOnFootArmed::IsPedInL: Corpus 1024; source corrected: leader->target direction with z = 0 and normalised, projection dir*dot (+ leader) with dot (y+z)+x, strict 4.0 and 100.0 tests, final dot product on the un-normalised vector (z+y)+x; boundaries 2.0 and 10.0.
function_scope.CTaskComplexKillPedOnFootArmed::LineOfSi: Corpus 1024; source corrected: dynamic thresholds (10000 ms / 9.0 by default; 5000 ms and 4.0 or 9.0 in an interior, or when the target is the player and CGame::currArea != 0 or mission-created, depending on m_eProcLevel >= 2), re-check only if MORE than the threshold has passed, null target tolerated in the movement check, crouched (bit 26 of +0x46C) uses position + 0.25 and standing uses the head (was reversed), positions computed before disabling the target vehicle collision.
